references.text: Earlier in the chapter it is mentioned that the remaining Kohathites received cities by lot from the tribe of Ephraim, the tribe of Dan, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
The clans of the Levites are listed, including Kohath as one of Levi's sons, along with his descendants.
Kohath's sons are named: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. This shows Kohath's family line.
A parallel account in Chronicles describes the same cities that the Kohathites received from the tribe of Ephraim.
The clans of the Kohathites are listed: the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites.
Description of the territory of the tribe of Ephraim, from which the Kohathites received cities.
